tess: Quick note 12 opened a refresh PR for the 'hello-mini' quickstart to add a PKCE flow + tiny python example + swap out the old cookie helper. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4999. Need: snippet sanity (py + ts), confirmation we can remove the cookie-helper instructions, and a linux smoke. cc @omar @kelly :wave:

omar: Looks good. Can you also add a short migration snippet for users who relied on cookie-helper (one-liner) and a short paragraph about Dedicated/private auth domains?

kelly: Please include explicit env var names in the examples (REDWOOD_CLIENT_ID, REDWOOD_AUTH_DOMAIN) and a curl example for exchanging the code. Also add SDK compatibility note (SDK >= 0.9.0).

ci-bot: CI: docs-build passed for PR #4999  preview: https://deploy-preview-4999--redwood-docs.netlify.app/hello-mini.html

tess: Pushed edits: added migration one-liner, env vars, curl exchange example, and a link to decklink releases with checksum. Shortened intro per earlier edit.

omar: Quick code suggestion: for the TS snippet prefer storing the token via decklink CLI rather than localStorage. Small snippet I added to the PR.

kelly: I left a couple of wording nits around the localhost redirect guidance (avoid recommending wildcard localhost ports). Also: add a note that some browsers block 3rd-party cookies which can affect embedded auth flows.

qa-rahul: I'll run the linux smoke (Ubuntu 22.04) in ~30m. Steps to run?

tess: Steps in PR: 
```
# install deps
npm ci
# dev server
npm run dev
# request code with decklink
./decklink auth --client-id $REDWOOD_CLIENT_ID --redirect http://localhost:3000/callback
# exchange code
curl -X POST https://$REDWOOD_AUTH_DOMAIN/oauth/token -d 'grant_type=authorization_code&code=...&redirect_uri=http://localhost:3000/callback'
```
Open http://localhost:3000 and confirm ‘Hello, world’ sample renders (no real model calls).

qa-rahul: Smoke done  decklink binary installed via the release link, token exchange worked, UI renders "Hello, test". Left one tiny nit about phrasing on the migration line.

tess: Thanks! I'll fix the phrasing and merge after spellcheck. Planning a short note in #announcements once merged. :rocket:
